title: Tibra Equities Europe Ltd Purchases Shares of 300,304 Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Tibra Equities Europe Ltd purchased a new stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) during the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund purchased 300,304 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock, valued at approximately $55,589,000. Apple accounts for about 8.3% of Tibra Equities Europe Ltd’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 2nd largest holding.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also bought and sold shares of the company. Northern Capital Management LLC boosted its position in Apple by 6.4% during the first quarter. Northern Capital Management LLC now owns 54,812 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,196,000 after purchasing an additional 3,298 shares in the last quarter. Usca Ria LLC boosted its position in Apple by 6.3% during the first quarter. Usca Ria LLC now owns 55,366 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,289,000 after purchasing an additional 3,280 shares in the last quarter. GFS Advisors LLC boosted its position in Apple by 87.2% during the first quarter. GFS Advisors LLC now owns 107,296 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $18,002,000 after purchasing an additional 49,981 shares in the last quarter. CCM Investment Advisers LLC boosted its position in Apple by 2.2% during the first quarter. CCM Investment Advisers LLC now owns 99,138 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $16,633,000 after purchasing an additional 2,101 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Chessman Wealth Strategies RIA purchased a new stake in Apple during the first quarter worth $205,000. 57.14% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
